# ai.toml: AI blocks: what a model's answer puts in, what it leaves alone, and what goes in when no model answers
# Written by cargo test -p aralo-core --test golden. Do not edit; bless it.
# Expanded at 2026-03-09 14:05:07 +01:00. | is the caret, [] a selection.

=== a model's answer goes in where the block was, and the text around it is the body's
--- en_US
field: "Hi Dana,\n\nThank you so much for ordering with us!\n\nBest, Sam|"
preview: "Hi ,\n\nThanks for your order.\n\nBest, Sam"
undo: 60 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Hi Dana,\n\nThank you so much for ordering with us!\n\nBest, Sam|"
preview: "Hi ,\n\nThanks for your order.\n\nBest, Sam"
undo: 60 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Hi Dana,\n\nThank you so much for ordering with us!\n\nBest, Sam|"
preview: "Hi ,\n\nThanks for your order.\n\nBest, Sam"
undo: 60 backspaces

=== with no model, a block puts in its fallback and says so
--- en_US
field: "Thanks, but not this time.|"
preview: "Thanks, but not this time."
undo: 26 backspaces
note: "No model answered this block (nothing here asks a model), so its fallback went in."
--- de_DE
field: "Thanks, but not this time.|"
preview: "Thanks, but not this time."
undo: 26 backspaces
note: "No model answered this block (nothing here asks a model), so its fallback went in."
--- ja_JP
field: "Thanks, but not this time.|"
preview: "Thanks, but not this time."
undo: 26 backspaces
note: "No model answered this block (nothing here asks a model), so its fallback went in."

=== a block with no fallback puts in nothing, and says so
--- en_US
field: "Before  after|"
preview: "Before  after"
undo: 13 backspaces
note: "No model answered this block (nothing here asks a model), and it has no fallback text, so nothing went in."
--- de_DE
field: "Before  after|"
preview: "Before  after"
undo: 13 backspaces
note: "No model answered this block (nothing here asks a model), and it has no fallback text, so nothing went in."
--- ja_JP
field: "Before  after|"
preview: "Before  after"
undo: 13 backspaces
note: "No model answered this block (nothing here asks a model), and it has no fallback text, so nothing went in."

=== a model's answer is literal text, even written as placeholders
--- en_US
field: "Answer: {{clipboard}} {{date}} {{field: who}} {{cursor}} \\{{|"
preview: "Answer: -"
undo: 60 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Answer: {{clipboard}} {{date}} {{field: who}} {{cursor}} \\{{|"
preview: "Answer: -"
undo: 60 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Answer: {{clipboard}} {{date}} {{field: who}} {{cursor}} \\{{|"
preview: "Answer: -"
undo: 60 backspaces

=== an answer of several lines goes in before the cursor stop
--- en_US
field: "Line one.\nLine two.\n|\nRegards"
preview: "Thanks.\n\nRegards"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "Line one.\nLine two.\n|\nRegards"
preview: "Thanks.\n\nRegards"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "Line one.\nLine two.\n|\nRegards"
preview: "Thanks.\n\nRegards"
undo: not by backspace

=== blocks are answered one by one, each by its own number
--- en_US
field: "one / 2|"
preview: "1 / 2"
undo: 7 backspaces
note: "No model answered this block (nothing here asks a model), so its fallback went in."
--- de_DE
field: "one / 2|"
preview: "1 / 2"
undo: 7 backspaces
note: "No model answered this block (nothing here asks a model), so its fallback went in."
--- ja_JP
field: "one / 2|"
preview: "1 / 2"
undo: 7 backspaces
note: "No model answered this block (nothing here asks a model), so its fallback went in."

=== a block with nothing to ask is never run and puts in its fallback
--- en_US
field: "Later.|"
preview: "Later."
undo: 6 backspaces
error: "Write what the model is to write: {{ai: a short thank-you}}. Until then this block puts in its fallback."
--- de_DE
field: "Later.|"
preview: "Later."
undo: 6 backspaces
error: "Write what the model is to write: {{ai: a short thank-you}}. Until then this block puts in its fallback."
--- ja_JP
field: "Later.|"
preview: "Later."
undo: 6 backspaces
error: "Write what the model is to write: {{ai: a short thank-you}}. Until then this block puts in its fallback."

=== cancelling at the AI preview puts back only what was swallowed
--- en_US
field: ";x |"
preview: "Soon."
undo: nothing was inserted
--- de_DE
field: ";x |"
preview: "Soon."
undo: nothing was inserted
--- ja_JP
field: ";x |"
preview: "Soon."
undo: nothing was inserted
